title: Cardinals "devastated and heartbroken" by death of Rondale Moore

sources.name: Yahoo Sports NFL
sources.title: Cardinals "devastated and heartbroken" by death of Rondale Moore
sources.description: NFL wide receiver Rondale Moore, who died on Saturday at the age of 25, was drafted by the Cardinals in 2021 and spent his first three NFL seasons in Arizona.
